thread:
mike: morning check-in — did: rolled back kv-evict experiment (saw 2.1% SLO regression), pushed debounce tuning to prod, verified autoscaler bugfix in staging. blocker: INC-278 still showing flapping on eu-west embed path, needs oncall confirmation before I escalate. today: finish canary ramp + run warmup job for embeddings and follow up on alert rule changes. ping @jay for canary window.
leah: saw the rollback metrics, thanks. i'll keep a close eye on the debounce alerts. quick ask — can you paste the small alert rule diff? saves me digging through the PR.
mike: sure — rule snippet below:
```
- alert: EmbedLatencyHigh
- expr: p50(embed_latency_ms{region="eu-west"}) > 150
+ alert: EmbedLatencyHigh
+ expr: increases(p50(embed_latency_ms{region="eu-west"})[5m]) > 20
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
leah: nice, that should cut down noise from transient spikes. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: INC-278 reopened by mike — tagging oncall
tara: @mike i've got the oncall window 14:00-18:00 today, can take initial triage if it crashes again. do you want me to mute non-critical alerts during the canary ramp? i can adjust debounce to 3m temporarily.
mike: yes please mute non-critical for the ramp. keep paging ones intact. if you toggle, post the mute window here.
jay: on the canary side — i'm seeing slower kv warmups on two nodes, probably due to shard imbalance. i'll shift 1 replica to the warm node and kick a warmup job at 14:10. will post the rollout link when live: https://ci.redwood/builds/2334
leah: i'll bookmark that build and watch logs. mike — for INC-278, can you attach the small heap and p50 token histogram you captured? helps triage.
mike: attaching snippets in the ticket, also left a quick comment in the PR. if it pages again, @tara take the page and escalate to eng-runtime after 15min. thanks everyone.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for emb-warmup (build 2334) — monitoring enabled
jay: will ping here when warmup completes. expected ~12m.
leah: quick FYI — updated the runbook entry for embed flaps with a recovery checklist (runbook link in ticket). small change: prefer `increases(...[5m])` to detect trending vs spikes.
mike: perfect. closing my check-in."
